description.text: Do you like talking shit about people but only when they can’t fight back? Then Respect the Dead is the podcast for you! Every week, Hoots and Caelan Conrad talk about people who sucked and are now (thankfully) dead! We're dragging all our least favorite corpses - from religious bigots to miserly billionaires, petty actors and even unsafe theme parks! It’s kinda like if My favorite Murder and Behind the Bastards had a baby.
